title: What Surgical Technologists Do
description: Surgical technologists are the sterile-field guardians of the operating room: preparing ORs, sterilizing and arranging instruments, draping patients, passing instruments to surgeons, handling specimens, and maintaining counts. They work in hospital ORs, ambulatory centers, and labor/delivery — where precision is life.
